idSuffix.description:
The suffix to append to the tool's id.
If not specified, a random suffix will be added (to allow multiple instances of the same method).

doNotPersist.description:
If true, the metadata instance and config will only be returned. Otherwise, both will
be persisted to package metadata.

**NOTE:** the package must be in dev mode to persist the tool metadata.

skipValidation.description:
The base version of {@link Genai.Agent.Tool.C3Method} currently only supports methods whose parameters
and return value are all primitives ({@see PrimitiveType}). If `skipValidation` is not set `true`, then
the method will be validated to ensure that it meets this requirement.

generateArgsLlmConfigName.description: The {@link Genai.UnstructuredQuery.Engine.ModelConfig} to be used for generating the arguments for the method call
